title: PolyCARP: condition-aware prediction of copolymer architecture
description:
PolyCARP predicts copolymer architecture from monomer structures and reaction conditions and retrieves similar literature experiments. It combines an XGBoost classifier with a nearest-neighbour lookup to distinguish alternating, random, and gradient regimes. This release includes extraction and modelling code, the frozen paper dataset, trained model, evaluation splits, and a demo that reproduces the paper's performance table. The underlying dataset contains 3,791 copolymerizations from 1,206 publications.

Prepared for the manuscript Condition-aware prediction of copolymer architecture. The release provides installation instructions, a model card, and scripts for reproducing the reported evaluation. Predictions retained by the voting model have test balanced accuracy (macro recall) of 0.805 and overall accuracy of 0.814 at 77% coverage.
